column1: # comment: "GMEOW lang:Sense \u2192 WordNet synset / interlingual-index (ILI) alignments, pivoted through a curl-validated Wikidata QID for the synset concept (synset offsets are version-unstable; the QID is the stable pivot). A synset is coarser than a GMEOW sense-with-contexts \u2014 closeMatch, never identity, and synset membership is never imported as sense identity."

column7: ex:senseCat aligns to the WordNet 'cat' (feline) synset, pivoted through wd:Q146 (cat — small domesticated carnivorous mammal). The synset is coarser than the GMEOW sense, so closeMatch.

ex:senseMouse aligns to the WordNet 'mouse' (rodent) synset, pivoted through wd:Q39275 (Mus — genus of mammals), matching the sense gloss 'any small rodent of the genus Mus'. The synset is coarser than the GMEOW sense, so closeMatch.
